title.narrative: (1.4) Analysis, translation and interpretation in relation to specific conflict-zone (Sagaing/Chin/Magway/Rakhine) (one consultant)

Identification, review, analysis and, as needed, summary or full translation and interpretation into English of Burmese-language source materials for incorporation into evidence packages and analytical products to be made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: 70 discrete items summarised or translated, based on review and analysis of Burmese language materials of undefined scope and, depending on need, interaction with anticipated twenty (20) human sources

actual.value: 75 discrete items in Burmese language summarized or fully translated into English and interactions with 22 sources carried out. Reviewed and analysed material incorporated into approximately 6 analytical products

title.narrative: (1.2) Analysis and translation of Burmese-language insider documents and detention-related documents (three consultants)

Review, analysis and, as needed, summary or full translation into English of Burmese language documents for incorporation into evidence packages and analytical products to be made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: 10,000 items reviewed or analysed and 500 summarised or translated

actual.value: Identification and review of approximately 28,500 items, of which approximately 1950 were summarized and 50 were fully translated into English. Reviewed and analysed material incorporated into approximately 8 analytical products

title.narrative: Burmese-language materials are more comprehensively and effectively incorporated into the Mechanism’s evidence packages and analytical products to be made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities to facilitate criminal proceedings against persons responsible for serious international crimes committed in Myanmar since 2011
Increased quantity and quality of evidence packages and analytical products for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: Incorporation of analysed items into 45 evidence packages and analytical products

actual.value: Incorporation of analysed items into approximately 33 unique evidence packages and/or analytical products

title.narrative: (1.1) Analysis and translation of Burmese-language military documents (one consultant)

Review, analysis and, as needed, summary or full translation into English of Burmese-language military documents, for incorporation into evidence packages and analytical products to be made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: 5,000 items reviewed and analysed and 250 summarised or translated

actual.value: Review and analysis of approximately 2,500 items in the Burmese language, of which approximately 1400 summarized into English. Reviewed and analysed material incorporated into approximately 3 analytical products

title.narrative: (1.3) Analysis and translation of open source material (two consultants)

Identification, review, analysis and, as needed, summary or full translation into English of Burmese language open source materials for incorporation into evidence packages and analytical products to be made available for sharing with relevant national, regional or international authorities

target.value: Burmese open source materials incorporated into 30 English-language analytical products

actual.value: Review and analysis of open source materials incorporated in approximately 23 analytical products.
